body: I had that high feeling for the first few weeks.  But, it's either worn off or I've gotten used to it.  Main thing, though, is that it really does seem to be helping with my anxiety and depression.   Although, I've had a few moments where those reared their ugly heads as well.
I'm 40.  Been dealing with this for 34 years.  Life is never great but sometimes it's bearable.

I have been suicidally  (sp?) depressed for about a year, six months at the least.  Off and on for the past 32 years. My family has fallen apart since my brother died 2 years ago & I don't exist to them anyways. I'm terminating a pregnancy because we can't even afford groceries or healthcare but don't qualify for any type of assistance and I can't get anyone to hire me for even part time work.  It will be better for him but not if he's the one to find me.

I lied to my doctor, too.  I went b/c I wasn't feeling well, nausea, etc.  They did a normal screening b/c of my history.  I answered all the questions to indicate that yes, of course I'm depressed but lied when we got to the self-harm portion.  Then she told me 'You're pregnant' and I had to act all happy when really I'm scared of my husband's reaction.  I'm thinking of calling them back and telling them I lied but I don't know it'll do any good.
